items.item_text: 01. Coast Community College District is committed to advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and anti-racism. As a leader in fiscal services, how do you see your role advancing equity and reducing inequities in outcomes and access? Please include brief examples demonstrating your commitment to these principles.

02. Describe your approach to leading a team in a fast-paced, high-demand fiscal services environment. What strategies do you use to drive high performance and ensure each team member contributes to collective success? How do you adapt your leadership when working across teams composed of managers, faculty, and staff from both fiscal and non-fiscal areas? Please include examples that demonstrate your effectiveness in these settings

03. Describe your responsibility and involvement in the development and oversight of an organization-wide budget. Include the size of the budget and the controls established. How did you ensure clear communication and participation with the involved leaders/managers and constituencies groups? Please include an example of a budget-related challenge you overcame.

04. Describe your experience with the implementation of a new financial system (e.g., ERP, payroll, position control, budgeting software). Include the systems you have utilized, particularly the ERP systems. What were some key challenges you encountered and how did you address them? What would you do differently to increase the success of the implementation?

05. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses are required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No
Note: D.E.I.A. - Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Accessibility, and Anti-Racism

The Coast Community College District (Orange Coast College, Golden West College, and Coastline) continues to strengthen our efforts around diversity, equity, inclusion, access, and anti-racism. The Coast Community College District is focused on creating a culture of inclusive excellence by uplifting employees and students through an environment that is equitable, diverse, inclusive, and accessible. We have a strong focus and importance on D.E.I.A. and Anti-Racism (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Accessibility) and will be actively listening, assessing, and evaluating this throughout each stage of the application, recruitment, and interview process.
